name: Kit (ConvertKit)
description: Email marketing platform for creators. Monitor account access and subscriber management.

config.setupInstructions:
1. Log in to Kit (formerly ConvertKit) at app.kit.com
2. Go to Settings (gear icon) > Advanced > API
3. Under "API Key (v4)", click Show and copy the key (this is the v4 key, distinct from the legacy v3 "API Secret")
4. Paste it below

Notes:
- Only Account Owners can view the v4 API key. Other roles will not see it in Settings.
- Comp AI uses the Kit v4 API at https://api.kit.com/v4 with the X-Kit-Api-Key header. Older v3 keys / API Secrets will not work.
